Spk I 115, 22 (~aṃ nisinnaṭṭhāne); Mp II 204, 17 (putto dārābharaṇaṃ paccupaṭṭhapetvā ~aṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pāṭi-ekkaṃ); 314, 17 (~aṃ ~aṃ nāmaṃ gahetvā, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se pāṭi-ekkaṃ); III 80, 6 (pāṭi-ekkaṃ gahitattā paccekasaṅkhātāni diṭṭhisaccāni) = Nidd-a I 88, 26 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr pāṭi-ekkhaṃ); It-a II 55, 29 (pañca sīlāni ekajjhaṃ ~aṃ vā samādiyantena); 108, 8 (yugavasena cattāri purisayugāni pāṭekkato aṭṭha purisapuggalā); Th-a I 134, 3 (tesaṃ ~aṃ kuṭikāyo kāretvā); Nidd-a I 368, 28 (paccattam evā ti pāṭekkam eva); As 142, 5 (imesaṃ ca phassapañcakānaṃ dhammānaṃ ~aṃ ~aṃ vinibhogaṃ katvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pāṭi-ekkaṃ); — see also paṭi-ekka.
